findings.mechanism: Backend value "local" may be missed by string comparisons against "sqlite" only; switch handles it but external consumers comparing config.MemoryBackend* values may not include the new "local" case.
findings.test: grep -rn 'Backend.*==.*"sqlite"' internal/ to find consumers that miss "local"
findings.evidence: SOURCE -- internal/config/schema.go adds MemoryBackendLocal; internal/memory/manager.go switch handles it; internal/configui/sections_memory.go lists it as option

findings.mechanism: sanitizeTerm does not strip FTS5 boolean operators (NOT, -) -- a user query "foo NOT bar" becomes "foo" NOT "bar" in the MATCH expression, allowing boolean syntax injection.
findings.test: SanitizeQueryOp("foo NOT bar", "AND") and verify output doesn't contain bare NOT
findings.evidence: LIVE -- sanitizeTerm removes "'()*: but not NOT, -, or other FTS5 operators

findings.mechanism: rows.QueryContext calls lack rows.Close() on error paths -- potential statement leaks.
findings.test: Code review of all rows, err := in internal/memory/ to verify Close on every path
findings.evidence: SOURCE -- dual_store.go:545 has no defer or explicit Close on error path

findings.mechanism: escapeLikeWildcards correctly escapes \, %, _ but the accompanying comment in episodic.go:237 is misleading about Go raw string semantics.
findings.test: Search with query containing \% and verify it's escaped to \\% in LIKE pattern

findings.mechanism: StartPeriodicConsolidation has no guard against being called twice with different contexts; consolidator's internal sync.Once prevents duplicate tickers but the manager-level call is not idempotent-checked.
findings.test: Call StartPeriodicConsolidation twice in quick succession and check for duplicate ticker goroutines
findings.evidence: SOURCE -- manager's StartPeriodicConsolidation only checks initialized and consolidator != nil

findings.mechanism: handler.go stamps timestamps with time.Now().UTC() while distill_async.go uses LOCAL calendar date for day buckets -- near-midnight memories may be bucketed to the wrong day.
findings.test: Create a memory at UTC midnight and check which day frame it lands in
findings.evidence: SOURCE -- handler.go uses .UTC(), distill_async.go uses LOCAL
